    Consent-tracked referral

    Apply Through ALO Education

    Start your verified application via ALO Education — our partner team handles your application end-to-end, with explicit consent tracking, no PII in URLs, and a 24-hour signed referral token.

    Book a free call first

    How the referral flow works

    Five simple steps — from clicking Apply to ALO Education contacting you.

    1. 1

      Click Apply on any card

      Every university, course, scholarship and PhD card has an orange 'Apply' button.

    2. 2

      Read the consent dialog

      We explain exactly what context is shared (no PII) and what ALO Education will do with it.

    3. 3

      Tick the consent box

      Your explicit opt-in is required. We record the consent timestamp + version for audit.

    4. 4

      Referral created (24h token)

      We create an audit record + sign a 24-hour referral token. You're redirected to ALO Education.

    5. 5

      ALO Education takes over

      The ALO Education team contacts you to start your application. You can revoke consent anytime.

    Why our referral is safe

    Four guarantees baked into every Apply click.

    No PII in URLs

    Your name, email, phone, address — none of it goes in the URL. Only public context (country, university, course slugs).

    24-hour signed token

    Referral tokens are HMAC-SHA256 signed and expire after 24 hours. After that, a fresh consent is required.

    Audited end-to-end

    Every referral transitions through created → transferred → completed/failed states, all logged for audit.

    You're in control

    Consent is reversible — email privacy@alaminn.info and we'll kill any active referral immediately.

    Common questions

    Is applying through ALO Education free?
    Yes — the consultation and application support from ALO Education is free for students. Universities pay ALO Education a commission on enrolment, which is why the service is free to you.
    Will I lose control of my application?
    No. You retain full visibility — ALO Education involves you at every step. You can withdraw consent at any time by emailing privacy@alaminn.info.
    What if I want to apply to a university not listed here?
    Use the general Apply CTA below — ALO Education handles applications to any accredited university worldwide.
